title: savedquery
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, organizationid.

advancedgroupby.description: Type the column name that will be used to group the results from the data collected across multiple records from a system view.

canbedeleted.description: Tells whether the view can be deleted.

columnsetxml.description: Contains the columns and sorting criteria for the view, stored in XML format.

conditionalformatting.description: Type information about how the items in the system view are formatted.

createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

description.description: Type additional information to describe the view, such as the filter criteria or intended results set.

enablecrosspartition.description: Tells whether the view can retrieve data from all cluster partitions.

fetchxml.description: String specifying the query in Fetch XML language.

introducedversion.description: Version in which the form is introduced.

iscustom.description: Tells whether a user created the view.

iscustomizable.description: Tells whether the component can be customized.

isdefault.description: Tells whether the view is the default view for the specified record type (entity).

ismanaged.description: Tells whether the record is part of a managed solution.

isquickfindquery.description: Choose whether the view is compatible with Quick Find.

isuserdefined.description: Tells whether the view was created by a user.

modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was last updated.

name.description: Type a name for the view to describe what results the view will contain.

offlinesqlquery.description: String specifying the corresponding sql query for the fetch xml specified for offline use.

organizationtaborder.description: For the organization, type the tab order to determine how users navigate through the screen using only the Tab key.

querytype.description: Shows the type of the query.

returnedtypecode.description: Type of entity displayed in the view.

roledisplayconditionsxml.description: Contains the role display conditions for the SavedQuery.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

statecode.description: Shows the status of the view.

statuscode.description: Shows the reason code that explains the status of the record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record on behalf of another user.

_organizationid_value.description: Choose the ID of the organization that the record is associated with.
